intro: All API Hub Personal Enhancement is a compliance-focused fork for New API-compatible relay sites and self-hosted instances. It centralizes accounts, balances, usage, model prices, and API credentials; adds staggered same-site check-ins and local announcement insights; supports channel tools and encrypted WebDAV backup; and hands visible security challenges to the user instead of bypassing them. Runtime updates, announcements, docs, and feedback point to qianbkk/all-api-hub.

privacyText: Sensitive data such as accounts, API keys, cookies, balances, request content, and user input stays local by default. Optional anonymous product analytics are used only to prioritize fixes for common issues, improve core workflows and compatibility, and reduce unnecessary friction, and they do not collect that sensitive data.
thanksDesc: The personal enhancement is maintained by qianbkk and built on the open-source work of upstream All API Hub and its contributors. Original attribution, licenses, and third-party notices are preserved.
